title: Sotto urges DICT to crack down on online sale of abortion drugs

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente “Tito” Sotto III on Friday urged the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) to crack down on social media pages or groups selling abortifacients and promoting abortion. Abortifacients are substances or drugs used to induce an abortion or terminate a pregnancy. “There are groups on Facebook promoting or supporting abortion in the Philippines… Just a quick search on Facebook would still result in numerous groups. In fact, in those groups you can see a lot of people offering abortifacients, which is illegal in our country,” Sotto noted during DICT’s budget deliberations at […]... Keep on reading: Sotto urges DICT to crack down on online sale of abortion drugs
